title: Quick Frozen Syrian Prawns Skewers
description: A floral and crisp Syrian dish featuring raw frozen prawns, this recipe is a festive and satvik-friendly option for any occasion, it is made with namul blanch season and is ready in no time
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the thawed prawns to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated prawns onto skewers.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Namul blanch season the skewers before serving for added flavor.
Repeat with remaining prawns and skewers.
